subject: Project ATLAS foundation repository
blocking_issues: Incomplete canonical data model and RLS policies

Complete canonical data and RLS contracts under ATLAS-54.
Build and test the pinned gbrain projector and gbrain-evals pilot adapter.
Execute all 14 release gates before productive publish.
